item.content:encoded: Interior view of a modern Onix data centre showing rows of server racks, raised flooring, structured cabling and a controlled technical environment. item.excerpt:encoded: Data sovereignty depends on more than location. It requires resilient infrastructure, secure operations and reliable systems designed to support critical workloads.

item.title: "The Future of Smart Cities in Africa: Envisioning Interconnected Urban Landscapes"
item.dc:creator: Samuel
item.content:encoded: This image captures the essence of a future African smart city, portraying an interconnected urban landscape where cutting-edge technology blends seamlessly with traditional African elements. The glowing lines and nodes symbolise the network of data centres, hinting at their critical role in powering these advanced urban environments. The depiction serves as a metaphor for the continent's potential to embrace a future where technology and culture converge, fostering unique solutions to Africa's urban challenges.
item.excerpt:encoded: Data Centres: The Silent Workhorse of Africa's Smart Cities - Pioneering a new era of urban innovation, efficiency, and sustainability

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: An artistic representation of a futuristic smart city skyline in Africa, with interconnected digital elements symbolising the role of data centres

item.title: Data Centre resilience in an earthquake
item.dc:creator: Samuel
item.content:encoded: This compelling image captures Onix Data Centre's facility in Accra, Ghana, situated in a disaster-stricken area. It serves as a testament to our robust infrastructure and resilience planning, designed to ensure uninterrupted service even in the most challenging conditions.
item.excerpt:encoded: Resilience in the Face of Adversity: Onix Data Centre's facility in Accra stands unyielding amidst a disaster zone, exemplifying our commitment to business continuity

item.title: healthcare onix 2
item.dc:creator: Samuel
item.content:encoded: This captivating image features a heart placed in a server rack, symbolising the seamless fusion of healthcare and advanced colocation services at Onix Data Centre. Our state-of-the-art facilities, including a solar farm and backup generators, ensure that healthcare organisations experience unparalleled reliability and sustainability.

item.title: What you saw vs what the server saw — latency comparison
item.dc:creator: onixdc
item.content:encoded: Realistic split view labelled “What you saw” and “What the server saw.” Demonstrates client–server timing mismatch that turns a local hit into a server-side miss. Generic environment and markers, no game IP.
item.excerpt:encoded: Lag changes where the server thinks players are. Every extra 1,000 km adds about 10 ms round-trip, so distance counts twice.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Two side-by-side gaming frames in a sci-fi corridor. Left panel shows the rival centred with a green aim marker. Right panel shows the rival a step ahead with a red aim marker, illustrating the server’s later position due to latency.

item.title: Keep Ghana traffic local: peering vs overseas detour
item.dc:creator: onixdc
item.content:encoded: The top row shows a short, direct path between two neighbours hand­ing off at an IXP. The bottom row shows the same traffic taking a long route via an airport. Use this to explain why peering in Accra reduces delay and failures for everyday apps.
item.excerpt:encoded: Local hand-off at an Internet Exchange Point lets nearby networks swap traffic directly. The overseas detour shows why keeping Ghana-to-Ghana traffic in country is faster and steadier.

item.content:encoded: A dark office affected by a power cut contrasted with a fully operational Tier IV data centre, illustrating the difference resilient infrastructure makes.
item.excerpt:encoded: A conventional office may grind to a halt during a power failure. A Tier IV data centre is engineered to keep critical services running.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: A dark office affected by a power cut contrasted with a fully operational Tier IV data centre, illustrating the difference resilient infrastructure makes.

item.title: Power Never Stops. It Simply Changes Direction.
item.dc:creator: onixdc
item.content:encoded: Electricity seamlessly transfers from the national grid to an uninterruptible power supply before continuing to critical server infrastructure.
item.excerpt:encoded: The UPS bridges the gap between utility power and backup generation, ensuring applications continue running without interruption.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Electricity seamlessly transfers from the national grid to an uninterruptible power supply before continuing to critical server infrastructure.

item.title: Backup Power Takes Over
item.dc:creator: onixdc
item.content:encoded: Backup generators automatically assume the electrical load while critical IT systems continue operating inside a Tier IV data centre.
item.excerpt:encoded: As the UPS maintains continuous power, the generators come online to support the facility for as long as required.

item.title: Onix - Services
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
Colocation Connectivity Services office Space Colocation

We provide a range of options to suit your colocation requirements. Our World Class Tier 4 custom built data centre currently houses 170 racks in module one. In future modules (from late 2021) we will offer private cages or IT rooms or even an entire module which meets the bespoke requirements of larger clients.

The infrastructure which has been certified Tier 4 by the Uptime Institute provides redundancy of power, cooling, connectivity and fire suppression. Our technical solution includes multi-layer access control, CCTV, BMS and DCIM with remote monitoring.

item.title: Office Space
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
Office Space

Our data centre is located 20 km from Accra. In order to ensure that your staff optimise their time we have built offices in the data centre allowing your staff working flexibility.

The data centre has over 200m² of office space furnished with modern chairs, desks and lockable cupboards. Rental is flexible and no long-term commitment required. We aim to make your data experience as efficient and pleasant as possible. Secure, separate offices or hot-desking open plan area.

  • Lockable storage units, chairs and desks
  • Meeting rooms
  • Access to kitchen facilities
  • Free WIFI included

item.title: It Takes an Entire Ecosystem to Keep One Rack Online
item.dc:creator: onixdc
item.content:encoded: An architectural cutaway illustrating the interconnected cooling, power, connectivity, fire protection and security systems that support a Tier IV data centre.
item.excerpt:encoded: Behind every server is an ecosystem of resilient infrastructure working together to maintain continuous operations.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: An architectural cutaway illustrating the interconnected cooling, power, connectivity, fire protection and security systems that support a Tier IV data centre.

item.title: While the City Waits, Business Continues
item.dc:creator: onixdc
item.content:encoded: Healthcare, finance, telecommunications, logistics, retail, manufacturing, professional services and security operations continue working because they are supported by resilient data centre infrastructure.
item.excerpt:encoded: Hospitals, banks, retailers, logistics providers and other organisations continue serving customers because resilient digital infrastructure keeps their critical systems online.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Healthcare, finance, telecommunications, logistics, retail, manufacturing, professional services and security operations continue working because they are supported by resilient data centre infrastructure.

item.title: The Lights Go Out. Does Your Business?
item.dc:creator: onixdc
item.content:encoded: A city experiences a widespread power outage while a Tier IV data centre remains fully operational, symbolising resilient digital infrastructure.
item.excerpt:encoded: When the grid fails, resilient infrastructure ensures critical digital services continue without interruption.

Office Space

Office Space

Our data centre is located 20 km from Accra. In order to ensure that your staff optimise their time we have built offices in the data centre allowing your staff working flexibility.

The data centre has over 200m² of office space furnished with modern chairs, desks and lockable cupboards. Rental is flexible and no long-term commitment required. We aim to make your data experience as efficient and pleasant as possible. Secure, separate offices or hot-desking open plan area.

  • Lockable storage units, chairs and desks
  • Meeting rooms
  • Access to kitchen facilities
  • Free WIFI included

item.title: I run a network
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
Peer at LINX  
Accra from Onix

Networks colocated at Onix can now access LINX Accra, the new Internet Exchange Point (IXP) for West Africa. LINX Accra is a fully redundant, interconnected, multi-site fabric designed to future-proof Ghana’s connectivity ecosystem.

Meet many with one

A single cross-connect into LINX Accra lets you peer with local ISPs, CDNs and global networks to keep traffic local.

Lower latency  and more control

Shorten paths, apply routing policy and reduce upstream dependency.

Route servers

Use LINX RS (AS8714) for instant multilateral peering; add bilaterals as you wish.

Simple pricing from LINX

$130

per month

iIncludes a 10GE port with 2 Gbps of peering service at all LINX-operated sites, plus LINX account management and 24/7 NOC. Additional service fees and options are published by LINX.

Claim your free cross-connect

Join LINX Accra today

item.title: I’m a business or user
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
Peering, in plain English

Think of delivery riders in Accra. If two neighbourhoods hand parcels to each other at a local hub, they don’t ship them via another city. Peering does the same for the internet. Networks meet at a neutral hub and hand off traffic right here in Ghana.

What this means for people

What this means for Businesses

Meet many with one

A single cross-connect into LINX Accra lets you peer with local ISPs, CDNs and global networks to keep traffic local.

Snappier cloud apps and fintech tools thanks to shorter routes.

More reliable connections

When there’s an issue on international links; local traffic still flows.

Improved user experience for  e-commerce, media, gaming and SaaS.

Data stays local

When both sides of a service are in Ghana.

Local reach to global platforms that connect to the exchange.

Better value over time

As networks reduce upstream costs and reinvest.

Where does Onix fit?

LINX Accra operates inside Onix’s Tier IV, carrier-neutral campus. If your network is at Onix,
order one cross-connect to LINX Accra and peer with many partners through a single connection.

item.title: Partners
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
African Infrastructure Investment Managers (AIIM) develops, creates, advises and manages private equity infrastructure funds. AIIM actively manages investments in East, West and Southern Africa. AIIM understands the African business environment and has experience spanning a range of infrastructure asset classes.

The funds are designed to invest long-term institutional unlisted equity in African infrastructure projects such as toll roads, renewable energy, ports, communication and accommodation infrastructure assets. AIIM has invested a significant amount of USD in Ghana across multiple energy projects including power generation and midstream energy. 

Learn More about AIIM

CKR Consulting Engineers address all built environment engineering consultancy needs by providing services in the Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, Structural, ICT infrastructure and ELV fields.

CKR, with its World Class customer service and dedicated engineering personnel with strong work ethic and accountability has positioned themselves to become one of the most technologically driven and sustainability focused consultancies.

CKR were responsible for the commissioning and certification of the facility.

Learn More about CKR

Client support

Welcome to ONIX Data Centres

Connecting Africa to the Globe

Please choose which data centre to visit

Ghana

Senegal

Who we are

Onix Data Centres Ltd, incorporated in London, owns and operates Data Centres in West Africa. Its flagship facility is the Tier IV certified, carrier neutral co-location facility, in Accra, Ghana. The Accra facility is the only Tier IV certified facility in the region. 

Learn more https://youtu.be/5U9poNOlQ64

Our partners

Testimonials

Our experience with Onix has been fantastic. The team is so professional and have always responded immediately to any of our distress calls. We expect this relationship to grow even stronger into the coming years.


Emmanuel Aidoo CTO - Vobiss We are looking forward to a mutually beneficial relationship with Onix. Onix Tier IV facility, with its green energy and excellent customer engagement is exactly what we have been looking for. Our customers have had a wonderful experience with Onix. If they are happy, we are happy. Koblah Gbeho CMO - Ecoband Networks Our working relationship with Onix has been excellent, the professionalism of the team is exemplary. We are particularly grateful for their hands and eye service and we are looking forward leveraging on the strengths of Onix to develop our own business. Henry Searyoh Commercial Director - Afriwave Telecom Our experience with Onix Data Centre has been exceptional. The team is professional, responsive, and always goes the extra mile. We are impressed with the Tier IV facility and our customers have had a great experience with Onix. We look forward to leveraging their expertise as we expand our network capabilities in West Africa and as Onix add more data centres to their portfolio across the region. Eduardo Puigcarbó TaboadaAFR-IX telecom

Get in touch with us today

Contact us

We deliver bespoke Data Centre Solutions for your African business requirements.

item.title: Services
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
• 🇬🇭
    • 🇸🇳
  • About Us
  • Services
  • Infrastructure
  • Blog
  • Contact Us

Colocation

We provide a range of options to suit your colocation requirements.

Our World-Class Tier IV data centre currently houses 170 3kW and 5kW racks in module one.

Our Tier IV certification ensures that our facility meets the highest industry standards for uptime and reliability.

Colocation allows businesses to share infrastructure and reduce costs while still maintaining control over their own equipment.

A pod of 30 or 50 racks available for individual clients

Carrier Neutrality

Affordable carrier-neutral data centre solutions for business with freedom of choice, maximum flexibility, reliability and affordability

Access to multiple cable operators, telcos, ISPs and IP Transit operators, offering capacity at varying prices and redundancy.

Cross connect to your business partners for secure connections.

Cloud and Content

Experience efficient delivery, scalability and reliability with our optimised cloud and content distribution solutions.

International cloud services providers enable compliance with data sovereignty laws and ensure customers can meet their varying requirements and spread their workloads across multiple providers.

Cloud and content distribution allows businesses to deliver their content and services more efficiently and with greater scalability.

Peering

Peering allows networks to directly connect and exchange traffic, improving communication and reducing IP transit costs.

By peering with other networks, businesses can improve the performance of their internet services and access new content and services.

Multiple IX exchanges provide redundancy and resiliency ensuring that there are multiple paths for traffic to travel between networks, improving latency.

Our team of experts can work with you to determine the best peering options for your business and ensure a smooth and seamless connection.

Colocation

[elementor-element k="846bd90cb64cec67a292b52002ee988e" data=""]

Our World-Class Tier IV data centre currently houses 170 3kW and 5kW racks in module one.

Our Tier IV certification ensures that our facility meets the highest industry standards for uptime and reliability.

Colocation allows businesses to share infrastructure and reduce costs while still maintaining control over their own equipment.

A pod of 30 or 50 racks available for individual clients

Carrier Neutrality

Affordable carrier-neutral data centre solutions for business with freedom of choice, maximum flexibility, reliability and affordability

Access to multiple cable operators, telcos, ISPs and IP Transit operators, offering capacity at varying prices and redundancy.

Cross connect to your business partners for secure connections.

Cloud and Content

Experience efficient delivery, scalability and reliability with our optimised cloud and content distribution solutions.

International cloud services providers enable compliance with data sovereignty laws and ensure customers can meet their varying requirements and spread their workloads across multiple providers.

Cloud and content distribution allows businesses to deliver their content and services more efficiently and with greater scalability.

Peering

Peering allows networks to directly connect and exchange traffic, improving communication and reducing IP transit costs.

By peering with other networks, businesses can improve the performance of their internet services and access new content and services.

Multiple IX exchanges provide redundancy and resiliency ensuring that there are multiple paths for traffic to travel between networks, improving latency.

Our team of experts can work with you to determine the best peering options for your business and ensure a smooth and seamless connection.

item.title: Infrastructure
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
Building

The Onix facility was built and designed considering earthquake and flood risk.

The facility is built 1.5m above the ground and is located 25km away from the city centre and industries for maximum safety and security.

This ensures that our facility is protected from natural disasters, minimising the risk of damage and downtime.

Building

The Onix facility was built and designed considering earthquake and flood risk.

The facility is built 1.5m above the ground and is located 25km away from the city centre and industries for maximum safety and security.

This ensures that our facility is protected from natural disasters, minimising the risk of damage and downtime.

Secure Power Supply

The Tier IV certified facility secures its power from the solar farm during daylight hours and from the power grid at night.

3 x 456kw generators in place should the solar and/or grid not be available.

The UPS ensures continuous cooling and power. The facility has fully redundant systems.

With an uptime of 99.995% redundancy is a key feature of Onix in Accra

Phase 1

The total area of the site is 7000m² with Phase 1 consisting of offices, guard house and the first two modules covering 1950m². 

Module #1 is fully operational and Module #2 requires the installation of additional mechanical and electrical infrastructure which will take less than four months to complete. 

Phase 2

Phase 2 will add an additional 1450m² of concrete buildings being modules 3 and  4 and as well as associated infrastructure. The infrastructure which has been certified Tier IV by the Uptime Institute provides redundancy of power, cooling, connectivity and fire suppression. 

Sustainable Operations

Onix solar farm has 2200 panels and provides daytime energy to the data centre, with a power peak of 640kW helping to reduce the reliance on grid energy.

The use of solar energy is an environmentally friendly solution that helps to reduce carbon emissions and promote sustainability.

The solar farm demonstrates the data centre's commitment to using innovative and sustainable solutions to power its operations.

Onix utilises ground water through reverse osmosis for all its water needs on site

Advanced Security Measures

Onix data centre in Ghana provides unparalleled security and fire protection, utilising advanced biometrics, physical security measures and state-of-the-art VESDA fire protection system to ensure maximum safety and security for your valuable assets and data.

This ensures that our facility is protected against unauthorised access and that any signs of fire are quickly and effectively put out, minimising the risk of damage and downtime.

Optimal Temperature Control

Our Data Centre features a state-of-the-art cooling system using cold aisle containment and climate control to ensure optimal temperature and humidity levels for your equipment.

This ensures that your equipment is protected from overheating and humidity damage, maximising its lifespan and performance.

UPS redundancy measures ensure that there are no fluctuations or power outages, ensuring continuous cooling.

Secure Interconnection Services

Onix Meet Me Room offers secure, convenient interconnection for networks and equipment, simplifying peering between two entities.

Partnering with leading industry providers to ensure the best service.

This allows businesses to easily connect their networks and equipment

Allows customers to easily switch between providers.

Comfortable
Business Space

In-house office space provides a secure and comfortable environment for your business operations, as either hot desks or private office rental space.

With over 200m² of furnished office space including modern chairs, desks, and lockable cupboards, our data centre allows your staff to optimise their time and work with flexibility.

Cross Connects

Onix Cross connect offers you direct connections to your business partners over a secure connection (Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure, PCCW Console Connect)

Cross connect directly to content delivery networks.

A cross connect allows you to connect directly to internet exchanges, enabling unlimited traffic across multiple networks.

We hope that this detailed information about our services and infrastructure provides you with a better understanding of how we can support your business needs. Our state-of-the-art data centre is designed to meet the demands of businesses of all sizes, and our team is dedicated to ensuring that you have the necessary infrastructure to thrive in today's digital age.

Get in touch with us today

Contact us

[elementor-element k="846bd90cb64cec67a292b52002ee988e" data=""]

Building

The Onix facility was built and designed considering earthquake and flood risk.

The facility is built 1.5m above the ground and is located 25km away from the city centre and industries for maximum safety and security.

This ensures that our facility is protected from natural disasters, minimising the risk of damage and downtime.

Building

The Onix facility was built and designed considering earthquake and flood risk.

The facility is built 1.5m above the ground and is located 25km away from the city centre and industries for maximum safety and security.

This ensures that our facility is protected from natural disasters, minimising the risk of damage and downtime.

Secure Power Supply

The Tier IV certified facility secures its power from the solar farm during daylight hours and from the power grid at night.

3 x 456kw generators in place should the solar and/or grid not be available.

The UPS ensures continuous cooling and power. The facility has fully redundant systems.

With an uptime of 99.995% redundancy is a key feature of Onix in Accra

Phase 1

The total area of the site is 7000m² with Phase 1 consisting of offices, guard house and the first two modules covering 1950m². 

Module #1 is fully operational and Module #2 requires the installation of additional mechanical and electrical infrastructure which will take less than four months to complete. 

Phase 2

Phase 2 will add an additional 1450m² of concrete buildings being modules 3 and  4 and as well as associated infrastructure. The infrastructure which has been certified Tier IV by the Uptime Institute provides redundancy of power, cooling, connectivity and fire suppression. 

Sustainable Operations

Onix solar farm has 2200 panels and provides daytime energy to the data centre, with a power peak of 640kW helping to reduce the reliance on grid energy.

The use of solar energy is an environmentally friendly solution that helps to reduce carbon emissions and promote sustainability.

The solar farm demonstrates the data centre's commitment to using innovative and sustainable solutions to power its operations.

Onix utilises ground water through reverse osmosis for all its water needs on site

Advanced Security Measures

Onix data centre in Ghana provides unparalleled security and fire protection, utilising advanced biometrics, physical security measures and state-of-the-art VESDA fire protection system to ensure maximum safety and security for your valuable assets and data.

This ensures that our facility is protected against unauthorised access and that any signs of fire are quickly and effectively put out, minimising the risk of damage and downtime.

Optimal Temperature Control

Our Data Centre features a state-of-the-art cooling system using cold aisle containment and climate control to ensure optimal temperature and humidity levels for your equipment.

This ensures that your equipment is protected from overheating and humidity damage, maximising its lifespan and performance.

UPS redundancy measures ensure that there are no fluctuations or power outages, ensuring continuous cooling.

Secure Interconnection Services

Onix Meet Me Room offers secure, convenient interconnection for networks and equipment, simplifying peering between two entities.

Partnering with leading industry providers to ensure the best service.

This allows businesses to easily connect their networks and equipment

Allows customers to easily switch between providers.

Comfortable
Business Space

In-house office space provides a secure and comfortable environment for your business operations, as either hot desks or private office rental space.

With over 200m² of furnished office space including modern chairs, desks, and lockable cupboards, our data centre allows your staff to optimise their time and work with flexibility.

Cross Connects

Onix Cross connect offers you direct connections to your business partners over a secure connection (Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure, PCCW Console Connect)

Cross connect directly to content delivery networks.

A cross connect allows you to connect directly to internet exchanges, enabling unlimited traffic across multiple networks.

We hope that this detailed information about our services and infrastructure provides you with a better understanding of how we can support your business needs. Our state-of-the-art data centre is designed to meet the demands of businesses of all sizes, and our team is dedicated to ensuring that you have the necessary infrastructure to thrive in today's digital age.

Get in touch with us today

Contact us

Our carrier-neutral data centre ensures freedom of choice and maximum flexibility for our clients. About Us

Who we are

Onix flagship facility is the Tier IV certified, carrier neutral co-location facility, in Accra, Ghana. The Accra facility is the only Tier IV certified facility in the region. As an enterprise class facility, the Data Centre offers stable, reliable, and uninterrupted service with an annual uptime of 99.995%.

As a neutral colocation facility, clients benefit from the ability to select carriers and internet exchanges providing IP transit services as well as well as cloud service providers. Tier IV cooling, fire suppression and back up power systems offer redundancy, mitigating for the use of the colocation facility in preference to building and maintaining an in-house facility.

item.title: Certification
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
At our data centre, we take the security and quality of our services very seriously. The certifications below demonstrate our commitment to providing our customers with the highest level of security and quality in all our operations.

Tier IV

Tier IV certification denotes a data centre's top-tier redundancy, fault tolerance, with 99.995% uptime.

ISO 27001:2013

ISO 27001:2013 is the international standard for information security management. It ensures the protection of sensitive company information.

ISO 9001:2015

ISO 9001:2015 is the international standard for quality management. It ensures consistent customer satisfaction and continuous improvement.

PCI-DSS

PCI-DSS certification involves meeting rigorous security standards set by the PCI SSC, ensuring the safe handling of card data for financial institutions and promoting secure customer transactions.

As a globally certified
Tier IV data centre, we have a lot to be proud of

We have an amazing facility and an amazing team.  We also have amazing processes. Our quality management system (QMS)conforms to ISO 9001:2015. This ensures that we are able to do things consistently and continually improve.  Our policies and process are the records of many years of our history and experience. Our experience translates into what we need to continue doing and what we have changed.  Our QMS makes our lives easier, it helps us produce accurate work, helps with onboarding nee members, and even changes in roles to other departments.  Most importantly, it make our service delivery to our customers a 5 star experience.

At Onix Data Centres, we are steadfast in our commitment to excellence, security, and continual improvement. Our adherence to ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 reflects our dedication to delivering consistent, high-quality services while ensuring the highest standards of information security.

Read the entire ISO 9001 & 27001 committment statement below

Take accountability and responsibility for the effectiveness of the Quality Management System and ensure that it meets its purpose.

Quality policies and objectives are established, importance communicated throughout the company and tracked for progress.

Ensure that the Quality Management System works together with our business processes; this is not a side project, its the way we work.

Promote process approach. Have a strong understanding of the principles of QMS. and embody these principles in all work, while encouraging the use of processes across Onix

Communicate the importance of conforming to the QMS and its requirements.

Provide adequate resources needed for the QMS; create effective organizational structures and provide right internal environment that motivates people towards achievement of organisation’s goals and objectives.

Engage, direct and support persons to contribute to the effectiveness of the Quality Management System. Top management will have involvement in all stages of QMS including planning, reviewing the results and suggesting improvements. Top management will show commitment towards processes to motivate others also to implement and improve processes.

Promote a culture of continual process improvements, take initiatives to develop new products and introduce new tools, to improve efficiency and productivity.

Maintain a consistent focus on customer requirements, meeting of regulatory or statutory requirements and enhancing customer satisfaction.
All the requirements shall be determined and met and confirming products or services provided to the customer.

Support other relevant management roles to ensure that all roles as required for effective implementation of QMS are available in the organization.

Support other relevant management roles to ensure that all roles as required for effective implementation of QMS are available in the organization.

Determine and address any risks that may hinder our ability to provide conforming products/services, or which may have a negative effect on customer satisfaction.

ISO 9001 & 27001 Commitment Statement

From the CEO, Razak Awudulai

At Onix Data Centres, we are steadfast in our commitment to excellence, security, and continual improvement. Our adherence to ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 reflects our dedication to delivering consistent, high-quality services while ensuring the highest standards of information security.

We pledge to:

  • Integrate Quality and Security: Embed quality management and information security principles into all business processes.
  • Maintain Compliance: Continuously meet regulatory, statutory, and customer requirements.
  • Promote Improvement: Foster a culture of continual improvement to enhance efficiency, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
  • Support Our Team: Equip our people with the necessary resources and environment to achieve excellence.
  • Protect Data: Identify and mitigate risks to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets.
  • Together, let’s build a future defined by trust, quality, and innovation.

Razak Awudulai
CEO, Onix Data Centres

Let's build this together!

ISO 9001 benefits you, the management and the customer!  If it does not, then it needs to be changed

Contact us

Tier IV

Tier IV certification denotes a data centre's top-tier redundancy, fault tolerance, with 99.995% uptime.

ISO 27001:2013

ISO 27001:2013 is the international standard for information security management. It ensures the protection of sensitive company information.

ISO 9001:2015

ISO 9001:2015 is the international standard for quality management. It ensures consistent customer satisfaction and continuous improvement.

PCI-DSS

PCI-DSS certification involves meeting rigorous security standards set by the PCI SSC, ensuring the safe handling of card data for financial institutions and promoting secure customer transactions.

As a globally certified
Tier IV data centre, we have a lot to be proud of

[elementor-element k="846bd90cb64cec67a292b52002ee988e" data=""]
[elementor-element k="846bd90cb64cec67a292b52002ee988e" data=""]
Read the entire ISO 9001 & 27001 committment statement below

Take accountability and responsibility for the effectiveness of the Quality Management System and ensure that it meets its purpose.

Quality policies and objectives are established, importance communicated throughout the company and tracked for progress.

Ensure that the Quality Management System works together with our business processes; this is not a side project, its the way we work.

Promote process approach. Have a strong understanding of the principles of QMS. and embody these principles in all work, while encouraging the use of processes across Onix

Communicate the importance of conforming to the QMS and its requirements.

Provide adequate resources needed for the QMS; create effective organizational structures and provide right internal environment that motivates people towards achievement of organisation’s goals and objectives.

Engage, direct and support persons to contribute to the effectiveness of the Quality Management System. Top management will have involvement in all stages of QMS including planning, reviewing the results and suggesting improvements. Top management will show commitment towards processes to motivate others also to implement and improve processes.

Promote a culture of continual process improvements, take initiatives to develop new products and introduce new tools, to improve efficiency and productivity.

Maintain a consistent focus on customer requirements, meeting of regulatory or statutory requirements and enhancing customer satisfaction.
All the requirements shall be determined and met and confirming products or services provided to the customer.

Support other relevant management roles to ensure that all roles as required for effective implementation of QMS are available in the organization.

Support other relevant management roles to ensure that all roles as required for effective implementation of QMS are available in the organization.

Determine and address any risks that may hinder our ability to provide conforming products/services, or which may have a negative effect on customer satisfaction.

ISO 9001 & 27001 Commitment Statement

From the CEO, Razak Awudulai

item.title: About Us
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
State-of-the-Art Data Centres in West Africa for Global Standards

Onix Data Centres Ltd. owns and operates world class carrier neutral colocation data centres across West Africa, delivering high speed and secure data services to enterprise, consumer and public sector markets.

The flagship facility is the Tier IV certified Data Centre in Accra, Ghana. The Data Centre in Dakar, Senegal is located at the 2Africa cable landing station and offers direct access to all major landing cables in Senegal.

Leading Provider of Tier IV Colocation in
West Africa

Onix is a leading provider of Carrier neutral colocation data centre services in West Africa focused currently on Ghana and Senegal. The state-of-the-art facilities are designed to meet the growing demands of businesses globally. Onix carrier-neutral data centres ensure freedom of choice and maximum flexibility for clients. Onix facilities are built to the highest industry standards, guaranteeing maximum uptime and reliability.

Onix has a world class executive team with a track record of success in Africa. Onix majority shareholder is African Infrastructure Investment Managers (Pty) Ltd (“AIIM”) who are committed to the long-term development of African infrastructure and the uplifting of its people.

Our Leadership Team

Michael Nahon

Chief Executive Officer

Paul Richards

Chief Financial Officer

item.title: Senegal 🇸🇳
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
1er neutral CLS datacenter en Afrique

Fournisseur de premier plan de colocation de niveau IV

Expertise et Engagement

Onix comprend l'importance d'avoir une infrastructure fiable et sécurisée pour les entreprises dans l'ère numérique actuelle. C'est pourquoi Onix a investi dans la dernière technologie et l'équipement pour fournir des services de centre de données à nos clients. Notre équipe d'experts se consacre à garantir la continuité de votre entreprise et nous nous efforçons d'être le fournisseur de référence pour la colocation et autres services de centre de données.

Learn more

Qui Sommes Nous

ONIX Datacenter au Sénégal c’est une infrastructure de Datacenter de dernière génération Neutre vis á vis des fournisseurs d’accès internet et idéalement situé á la station d’atterrissage du câble 2Africa.
Ce centre sera équipé des dernières technologies en matière de sécurité, de refroidissement, d’alimentation énergétique et de redondance pour satisfaire á la certification Uptime Tier 3. Nos installations permettront ainsi de garantir á nos clients un taux de disponibilité des ressources hébergées de 99,98% ce qui représente une indisponibilité annuel maximale de moins de 1h30mn. 

Avec des services allant de l’hébergement de ressources communément appelé colocation, au cloud avec des partenaires tels que Microsoft Azure, AWS, ou encore Console Connect : sans oublier les solutions de sécurité managées via CCDOC ; nous sommes confiants que ce centre répondra aux besoins croissants de nos clients en matière de services sécurisés et de traitement rapide des données.

Learn more https://youtu.be/22WgXMUpLaM

We deliver bespoke Data Centre Solutions for your African business requirements.

item.title: Services
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
Colocation

Nous proposons une gamme d'options pour répondre à vos besoins de colocation.

Notre centre de données de niveau III de classe mondiale abrite actuellement un module de 300m2. Le module 1 est équipé de 66 racks de 47u et de 200kW de puissance de calcul IT

La colocation permet aux entreprises de partager l'infrastructure et de réduire les coûts tout en gardant le contrôle sur leur propre équipement.

Notre certification de niveau III garantit que notre installation répond aux normes les plus élevées de l'industrie pour le temps de fonctionnement et la fiabilité.

Neutralité de l'opérateur

Solutions de centre de données neutres en termes d'opérateur à un prix abordable pour les entreprises avec liberté de choix, flexibilité maximale, fiabilité et abordabilité

Connectez-vous en croisé à vos partenaires commerciaux pour des connexions sécurisées.

Accès à plusieurs opérateurs de câbles, télécommunications, ISPs et opérateurs de transit IP, offrant une capacité à des prix variés et une redondance.

Cloud et Contenu

Expérimentez une livraison efficace, une évolutivité et une fiabilité avec nos solutions optimisées de cloud et de distribution de contenu.

Les fournisseurs de services cloud internationaux permettent de se conformer aux lois sur la souveraineté des données et assurent que les clients peuvent répondre à leurs exigences variées et répartir leurs charges de travail entre plusieurs fournisseurs.

La distribution de contenu et de cloud permet aux entreprises de livrer leur contenu et leurs services de manière plus efficace et avec une plus grande évolutivité.

Interconnexion

L'interconnexion permet aux réseaux de se connecter directement et d'échanger du trafic, améliorant la communication et réduisant les coûts de transit IP.

En s'interconnectant avec d'autres réseaux, les entreprises peuvent améliorer les performances de leurs services Internet et accéder à de nouveaux contenus et services.

Plusieurs échanges IX assurent la redondance et la résilience en garantissant qu'il existe plusieurs chemins pour que le trafic voyage entre les réseaux, améliorant la latence.

Notre équipe d'experts peut travailler avec vous pour déterminer les meilleures options d'interconnexion pour votre entreprise et assurer une connexion fluide et sans faille.

item.title: Infrastructure
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
Bâtiment

L'installation d'Onix a été construite et conçue en tenant compte des risques de tremblements de terre et d'inondations.

L'installation est construite à 1,5m au-dessus du sol et se trouve à 25km du centre-ville et des industries pour une sécurité et une protection maximales.

Cela garantit que notre installation est protégée contre les catastrophes naturelles, minimisant le risque de dommages et d'arrêts.

Previous Next

Alimentation électrique sécurisée

2 U.P.S indépendants (2 x 300kVA pour la charge IT)

2 générateurs de secours (48 heures d'énergie à pleine capacité) sont en place si le réseau n'est pas disponible.

L'UPS assure un refroidissement et une alimentation continus. L'installation dispose de systèmes entièrement redondants.

Avec un temps de fonctionnement de 99,995%, la redondance est une caractéristique clé d'Onix à Accra

Opérations durables

Onix utilise l'eau souterraine par osmose inverse pour tous ses besoins en eau sur site

Mesures de sécurité avancées

Le centre de données d'Onix à Dakar offre une sécurité et une protection contre l'incendie inégalées, utilisant des biométries avancées, des mesures de sécurité physique et un système de protection contre l'incendie VESDA de pointe pour garantir une sécurité et une protection maximales pour vos actifs et données précieuses.

Cela garantit que notre installation est protégée contre les accès non autorisés et que tout signe d'incendie est rapidement et efficacement éteint, minimisant le risque de dommages et d'arrêts.

Contrôle optimal de la température

Notre centre de données est équipé d'un système de refroidissement de pointe utilisant une contention d'allée froide et un contrôle du climat pour assurer des niveaux optimaux de température et d'humidité pour votre équipement.

Cela garantit que votre équipement est protégé contre la surchauffe et les dommages dus à l'humidité, maximisant sa durée de vie et ses performances.

Les mesures de redondance de l'UPS garantissent qu'il n'y a pas de fluctuations ou de coupures de courant, assurant un refroidissement continu.

Services d'interconnexion sécurisés

Accès à plusieurs câbles sous-marins (ACE, SAT3, MainOne et 2Africa)

Accès aux fournisseurs de cloud

Partenariat avec les principaux fournisseurs de l'industrie pour garantir le meilleur service.

Permet aux clients de passer facilement d'un fournisseur à un autre.

Cela permet aux entreprises de connecter facilement leurs réseaux et leurs équipements

La salle de rencontre d'Onix offre une interconnexion sécurisée et pratique pour les réseaux et l'équipement, simplifiant l'interconnexion entre deux entités.

Espace sur le toit disponible pour l'équipement satellite et d'antenne

Secure
Power Supply

Guaranteed secure power supply with our in-house solar farm, grid energy, and backup generator system, including various UPS for full energy redundancy at our Data Centre.

This ensures that our facility has a reliable and secure power supply, minimizing the risk of power outages and downtime.

Advanced Security Measures

Our Data Centre provides unparalleled security and fire protection, utilizing advanced biometrics, physical security measures and state-of-the-art VESDA fire protection systems to ensure maximum safety and security for your valuable assets and data.

This ensures that our facility is protected against unauthorized access and that any signs of fire are quickly and effectively put out, minimizing the risk of damage and downtime.

Espace d'affaires confortable
(PAS DE DÉTAILS POUR L'INSTANT sur DAKAR)

L'espace de bureau interne offre un environnement sûr et confortable pour vos opérations commerciales, sous forme de bureaux chauds ou de location d'espace de bureau privé.

Avec plus de 200m² d'espace de bureau meublé, comprenant des chaises modernes, des bureaux et des armoires verrouillables, notre centre de données permet à votre personnel d'optimiser leur temps et de travailler avec flexibilité.

Cross Connects

Onix Cross Connect vous offre des connexions directes avec vos partenaires commerciaux via une connexion sécurisée (Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure, PCCW Console Connect)

Connectez-vous directement aux réseaux de diffusion de contenu.

Une connexion croisée vous permet de vous connecter directement aux échanges Internet, permettant un trafic illimité sur plusieurs réseaux.

item.title: About us
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
Premier fournisseur de colocation de niveau 3 :

Ce nouveau Datacenter Neutral CLS de dernière génération bénéficiera d’une multi redondance à tous les niveaux.

En tant qu'installation de colocation, les clients bénéficient de systèmes de refroidissement de classe mondiale, de systèmes d'extinction d'incendie et d'une redondance d'énergie de secours avec des coûts minimes par rapport à la construction et à la maintenance d'une installation de données interne.

Savoir-faire et engagement

Nous comprenons l'importance d'avoir une infrastructure fiable et sécurisée pour que les entreprises puissent fonctionner à l'ère numérique d'aujourd'hui. C'est pourquoi nous avons investi dans les dernières technologies et équipements pour fournir les meilleurs services de centre de données à nos clients. Notre équipe d'experts se consacre à faire en sorte que votre entreprise dispose de l'infrastructure nécessaire pour prospérer à l'ère numérique d'aujourd'hui. Nous nous engageons à fournir les meilleurs services de centre de données aux entreprises au Senegal et dans la région, et nous nous efforçons d'être le fournisseur incontournable pour la colocation et d'autres services de centre de données.

https://youtu.be/D2XdouphAFA

item.title: Infrastructure Innovation
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
The Infrastructure Behind
Innovation:
Building Ghana's Digital Core

An exclusive gathering of leaders shaping the future of Ghana's digital economy.

24 September 2025

Accra

Reserve your place

Event Countdown

DaysHoursMinutesSeconds

Where Vision
Meets Capability

On 24 September 2025, Onix Data Centres and Spectrum Fibre will host a high-level event bringing together government, industry, and innovation leaders to focus on the digital infrastructure powering Ghana's growth. This is where vision meets capability, and where the backbone of tomorrow's technology is built today.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XHOmBV4js_E

Why Attend

Strategic Leaders

Engage with leaders shaping national digital strategy.

Infrastructure Insights

Gain insight into the infrastructure that enables Ghana's tech ambitions.

Live Innovation

Experience innovations built on our infrastructure in a live pitch showcase.

Key Stakeholders

Connect with key stakeholders across multiple sectors.

Event Details

Date

24 September 2025

Time

[Time]

Venue

[Venue]

Programme Highlights

Expert Insights

Expert insights on resilience, interconnection, and growth.

Future Preview

Ghana in 2030: A vision of the digital future.

Pitch Competition

Showcasing innovations built on our infrastructure.

Networking

Connect with decision-makers and innovators.

About the Organisers

Onix Data Centres

  • Ghana's first Tier IV, carrier-neutral facility.
  • Highest global standard for uptime and reliability.

Sustainable Practices at
Onix Data Centre

At Onix Data Centre in Accra, we're committed to green energy, powered by our 2,200-panel solar farm. This eco-friendly choice reduces our carbon footprint, lowers our energy costs, and ensures a scalable energy solution as we grow. Additionally, we meet all our water needs sustainably using ground water and reverse osmosis.

Commitment to a
Greener Future

Reducing Our Carbon Footprint

Aligned with our commitment to a sustainable and greener future, we are actively reducing our carbon footprint and promoting renewable energy, in accordance with the UN global objectives for 2025 and 2050.

Solar Power
Generation

Our Solar Farm

Onix Data Centre's solar farm generates 640 kW of renewable energy, covering 100% of our daytime needs. With battery banks soon to be installed, we will power the data centre 24/7 sustainably, reinforcing our commitment to clean, eco-friendly technology.

Water
Management

Responsible Water Usage

Onix Data Centre's reverse osmosis system treats and reuses underground water, using only what's needed and returning the rest to the ground. This minimises waste and reflects our dedication to sustainability.

Waste
Management

Sustainability Through Recycling

Solid waste from Onix Data Centre, including plastics, is sent to a recycling plant, sorted, and recycled, underscoring our commitment to sustainability.

Energy
Efficiency

Intelligent Cooling

Onix Data Centre's cooling system is optimised for low IT load, using only two of six 104 kW CRAC units to minimise energy use. The six interconnected cooling units work together, efficiently expelling heat from the datahall. Enhanced by our advanced cold aisle containment system, this integration delivers outstanding efficiency.

Our
Sustainability
Vision

Setting New Standards

At Onix DC, sustainability isn't just a buzzword; it's an integral part of our operations, setting new standards for environmentally conscious businesses.

Join us on our journey
towards a sustainable future

Contact us

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
Onix Data Regulations

Cybersecurity

Data
protection

Legal
Responsibilities

Regulation of Investigatory Powers

Privacy Policy

Learn more about how Onix Data Centre collects and uses data and your rights.

1. Introduction

Onix Data Centres Ghana Limited ("Onix", "we", "us") is committed to protecting the privacy and personal data of individuals in accordance with the Ghana Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843). This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, share, and safeguard personal information through our services, operations, and facilities.
This Policy applies to clients, partners, website users, vendors, visitors, employees, and any individual whose personal data we collect or process.

2. Personal Data We Collect

We may collect and process the following categories of personal data:

  • Identification Data: Name, national ID, passport, company name, job title.
  • Contact Details: Phone number, email, postal address.
  • Biometric Data: Fingerprints or facial data for access control (with consent).
  • CCTV Footage: Captured within and around our facilities.
  • Digital Identifiers: IP address, browser/user agent information (for website use).
  • Employee & Vendor Data: Bank details, SSNIT number, education/employment history.
  • Cookies and Device Data: Information gathered through our website (see Section 12).

3. How We Use Your Data

We process your personal data for the following lawful purposes:

  • To provide data centre services and facility access.
  • To fulfil contractual and legal obligations.
  • For internal operations including HR and vendor management.
  • To enhance safety and security through biometric and video surveillance.
  • To manage client communications and service improvement.
  • To comply with requests from regulatory authorities.

4. Legal Basis for Processing

Our processing is based on one or more of the following:

  • Your consent, where required.
  • Contractual necessity, such as service delivery.
  • Legal obligations, including statutory reporting.
  • Legitimate interests pursued by Onix or a third party, provided your rights are not overridden.

5. How We Obtain Your Data

Personal data may be obtained:

  • Directly from you via forms, access systems, or communication.
  • From third parties, with your consent.
  • Through our IT systems, including CCTV, biometric readers, and website logs.

6. Sharing of Personal Data

We may share your data with:

  • Authorized service providers (e.g., IT, access control, and security contractors).
  • Legal or regulatory authorities, when required by law.
  • Auditors, legal advisors, or insurers under confidentiality agreements.

We do not sell personal data.

7. International Transfers

We may transfer personal data outside Ghana only if:

  • The destination country offers adequate data protection safeguards; or
  • You have given explicit consent; or
  • It is necessary for contractual performance; or
  • There are appropriate safeguards (e.g., Standard Contractual Clauses) in place.

All international transfers comply with Section 40 of the Ghana Data Protection Act.

8. Your Rights

You have the following rights under the Ghana Data Protection Act:

  • Right to access your personal data.
  • Right to rectify inaccuracies.
  • Right to erasure of data (under certain conditions).
  • Right to object to processing.
  • Right to prevent direct marketing.
  • Right to restrict processing.
  • Right to lodge a complaint with the Data Protection Commission.

To exercise your rights, contact our Data Protection Officer (see Section 14).

9. Data Retention

We retain personal data only as long as necessary for:

  • The purpose for which it was collected.
  • Regulatory or legal requirements.
  • Contractual obligations.

Once no longer required, data is securely deleted, anonymized, or destroyed.

10. Data Security

We use physical, organizational, and technical safeguards to protect personal data, including:

  • 24/7 CCTV surveillance
  • Biometric access control
  • Encrypted systems and password protection
  • Role-based access and internal audits
  • Secure disposal of physical documents

11. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

This website uses only essential and performance-related cookies to ensure smooth operation and understand general usage patterns through anonymous data, such as visit counts and time spent on pages.

We do not use advertising, tracking, or third-party cookies, nor do we collect any personal data. Since our cookies are limited to core functionality and analytics, no active user consent is required. You can always delete cookies from your browser settings, and if you have more questions, visit www.allaboutcookies.org for more information.

12. Data Breach Notification

In the event of a data breach:

  • We will notify the Data Protection Commission promptly where applicable.
  • Affected individuals will be informed if there is a risk to their rights and freedoms.
  • Investigations will be conducted and remedial action taken.

13. Policy Updates

We may update this policy to reflect changes in law or operations. Updated versions will be posted on our website and available upon request.

14. Contact Us

Data Protection Officer

Kevin Opata

Facilities Manager

kevin@onixdatacentres.com

+233 59 874 6584

item.title: Sustainability
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
• 🇬🇭
    • 🇸🇳
  • About Us
  • Services
  • Infrastructure
  • Blog
  • Contact Us

Nous sommes engagés en faveur de solutions énergétiques durables et respectueuses de l'environnement

C'est pourquoi nous avons installé une ferme solaire de pointe de 2200 panneaux sur notre site pour fournir de l'énergie diurne à l'installation. Voici quelques-uns des avantages de notre ferme solaire.

Source d'énergie fiable

Notre ferme solaire produit une quantité significative d'énergie pendant les heures de jour, fournissant une source d'énergie fiable et durable pour notre centre de données.

Empreinte carbone réduite

En utilisant l'énergie solaire, nous sommes en mesure de réduire significativement notre empreinte carbone et de contribuer à un environnement plus propre et plus durable.

Coût-efficacité

L'utilisation de l'énergie solaire nous permet de réduire significativement nos coûts énergétiques et de répercuter ces économies sur nos clients.

Evolutivité

Au fur et à mesure que notre centre de données se développe, nous avons la possibilité d'étendre facilement notre ferme solaire pour répondre à nos besoins énergétiques croissants.

Ferme solaire

En utilisant notre ferme solaire pour alimenter notre centre de données, nous sommes en mesure de fournir un service plus durable et plus rentable à nos clients.

Rejoignez-nous dans notre voyage
vers un avenir durable

Contactez-nous

Welcome to Onix Data CentresOnix is the leading provider of Tier IV Colocation data centre services in Ghana. Our state-of-the-art facility is designed to meet the growing demands of businesses in Ghana and the region. Our carrier-neutral data centre ensures freedom of choice and maximum flexibility for our clients. About UsVirtual MachinesMaximise efficiency with VMs, offering direct access to Ghana's top networks.Our SolutionsManaged ServicesBoost IT reliability with our comprehensive Managed Services.Learn MoreCyber SecurityDefend against cyber threats with cutting-edge security measuresLearn MoreInternet ExchangeEnhance connectivity, reduce latency and costs with our Internet ExchangeLearn MoreColocationAchieve unparalleled uptime in our Tier IV certified Colocation facilityLearn MoreCloud and ContentEfficiently scale and deliver with our Cloud and Content solutionsLearn MoreSecure Power SupplyEnsure continuous operation with our robust power backup systems.Learn MoreSustainable OperationsEmbrace sustainability with operations powered by our solar farm, a first in West Africa.Learn MoreAdvanced Security MeasuresProtect your assets with advanced security and fire protection systems at our Ghana centre.Learn More Previous Next

Who we are

Onix flagship facility is the Tier IV certified, carrier neutral co-location facility, in Accra, Ghana. The Accra facility is the only Tier IV certified facility in the region. As an enterprise class facility, the Data Centre offers stable, reliable, and uninterrupted service with an annual uptime of 99.995%.

As a neutral colocation facility, clients benefit from the ability to select carriers and internet exchanges providing IP transit services as well as well as cloud service providers. Tier IV cooling, fire suppression and back up power systems offer redundancy, mitigating for the use of the colocation facility in preference to building and maintaining an in-house facility.

We provide a range of options to suit your colocation requirements.

item.title: Why Africa Corporations Should Host Their Data in Carrier Neutral Data Centres, Not In House
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
T he African data centre market consists primarily of in-house data centres built by banks, Telco’s and Governments for their own use. This has been a function of the lack of availability of carrier neutral data centres. However this is changing with the advent of companies like Teraco which are building World Class Tier 3 + data centres which use the latest technologies for managing power and cooling. The power and cooling requirements of new technology servers and high density suites is leading to many legacy data centre facilities being unable to deliver the energy efficiency benefits of a new purpose-built facilities. The operating costs of older data centres are thus becoming increasingly prohibitive with the life time cost of power exceeding the cost of building a new data centre.
Standout quote by one of the top execs at Onix to backup the above paragraph. - Name here
The increased requirement for digital and physical security has lead corporations to seek better and ultimately cheaper solutions by going outside the corporation and into the data centre. Carrier neutral data centres can offer much better physical and digital security, than going in-house, by using the most advanced technologies. This includes physical access control incorporating biometric access down to the rack level, video surveillance and 24/7 security. Digital security is also enhanced particularly in Cloud data centres with the use of high level encryption, deep packet inspection technologies and DDOS protection of customers data. There is the small matter of data sovereignty which requires the hosting of data to be done in –country in particular when it comes to banks, Governments and health care providers. Regulators are increasing enforcing this requirement in light of the spate of data breaches globally which are reported on a daily basis and the manifest intrusion by global agencies like the NSA et al. Latency is gradually becoming an increasing factor in Africa as more and more video content is consumed and more and more Africans go online. Amazon report a 1% drop in sales for every 100ms of latency. Google reports a 20% drop in traffic for each 0.5sec delay in page generation. There is thus an increasing requirement that the content be hosted locally and not in servers in Europe or the US. The explosion of Internet users in Africa driven, inter-alia, by the rapid take-up of smart phones means that they are increasingly consuming and/or creating streaming video, social networking and Internet gaming leading to increased requirements of bandwidth and storage. Africa is leading this trend and between 2015 and 2020 showed a compound annual growth rate of over 50% in Cloud traffic. By 2018, more than 50 percent of the global consumer Internet population was using personal cloud storage. There is a manifest shortage of IT skills in Africa. It will be a much more efficient use of these scarce skills if they can be deployed in data centres than spread out amongst various firms which don’t have critical mass. These demands can only be met by the roll out of many more carrier neutral data centres in Africa, the total aggregate capacity of which - is less than half of that of those located within the M25 in London.

item.title: ONIX DC ACCRA - The Only Climate Friendly Data Centre in West Africa
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded: The upcoming COP Conference to be held in Glasgow has put the climate on top of the agenda for every corporation, Government and institution in the world.   Mankind has watched in horror as wildfires, heatwaves, extreme weather events and record-breaking temperatures have assailed many parts of the globe during this last Northern summer. It is our collective responsibility to act with alacrity to reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions.   The use of fossil fuels must be dramatically reduced to save the planet.   The actions of individual actors such as Lewis Pugh  have placed a spotlight on the impact of climate change on the polar regions which now needs to be acted upon. The data centre industry is acknowledged as a major energy consumer and hence contributor to global warming. Many companies who rely on data centres most notably the ‘Hyperscalers’ have already started going green by installing renewable sources to power their in-house data centres.  This is to be lauded. However, the majority of other data centre operators remain well behind the curve.  In Africa most data centres rely either on the grid (if actually operational) or on generators (usually diesel powered). It is time for their customers to demand change.  Consumers are so often the drivers of social and technological change.   If you knew that your Google search or Facebook post was powered by a green data centre versus a fossil fuel powered data centre - would you care?   Given the prevailing climate calamity we would posit that consumers do care - a lot. There are very few solar powered data centres in Africa.  In Ghana, ONIX is setting the trend by using a solar farm alongside its Tier 4 data centre as its primary power source.    The data centre is located outside of Accra on a site which is surrounded by extensive open land. This land has already been secured for future expansion of the data centre and the solar farm. Customers of the ONIX data centre can be assured that they are doing everything possible to address the climate emergency.   This should be one of the critical criteria when considering taking your IT requirements off premise.   Very soon your own customers will start demanding you do so ….

item.content:encoded:
Michael Nahon

Chief Executive Officer

I am the CEO of Onix Data Centers Ltd. The initial Onix Data Center, in Accra, Ghana, is the only Tier 4 certified DC in the region and has the relevant ISO certifications (ISO 27001, ISO 9001 PCI). The facility had a successful launch and is equipped with 170 racks with space to expand into a second module, which will be a high density module with 1000kw of compute power.

item.title: Our Solutions
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
Welcome to Onix Data Centres!

Here, we offer bespoke solutions tailored to your unique needs. Our team is ready to help you find the perfect fit. Explore below to see how we can elevate your data management, with streamlined efficiency and top-tier security.

Colocation

We provide a range of options to suit your colocation requirements.

Our World-Class Tier IV data centre currently houses 170 3kW and 5kW racks in module one.

Our Tier IV certification ensures that our facility meets the highest industry standards for uptime and reliability.

Colocation allows businesses to share infrastructure and reduce costs while still maintaining control over their own equipment.

A pod of 30 or 50 racks available for individual clients

Virtual Machines

Flexibility and Efficiency

VMs enable running multiple, isolated operating systems on a single server, enhancing resource efficiency.

Security and Scalability

Each VM operates independently, ensuring secure, scalable environments for business growth.

Rapid Deployment

Facilitates swift setup of new applications or services without additional hardware.

Expert Support

Our team delivers bespoke solutions, optimising VM performance for your specific requirements.

Read more

Managed Services

Comprehensive IT Support

Our Managed Services provide full IT support, ensuring operational efficiency and reliability.

Proactive Monitoring

Continuous monitoring to preemptively address issues, maintaining system integrity.

Data Backup and Recovery

Robust solutions for data protection, ensuring business continuity with quick recovery from disruptions.

Cyber Security

Advanced Threat Protection

Utilising cutting-edge technologies to defend against sophisticated cyber threats, safeguarding your digital assets.

Continuous Security Monitoring

Round-the-clock surveillance of your systems to detect and mitigate risks promptly.

Incident Response

Swift action to manage and neutralize security breaches, minimizing potential impacts.

Compliance and Governance

Ensuring your IT practices meet regulatory standards, protecting data integrity and privacy.

Internet Exchange

Direct Connectivity

Establishing direct routes between networks, enhancing speed and reducing latency for data exchange.

Cost Efficiency

Lowering operational costs by reducing reliance on external transit networks for data routing.

Improved Performance

Enhancing user experience through faster and more reliable internet services.

Network Resilience

Offering robust paths for data, ensuring continuous service even during network disruptions.

Carrier Neutrality

Affordable carrier-neutral data centre solutions for business with freedom of choice, maximum flexibility, reliability and affordability

Access to multiple cable operators, telcos, ISPs and IP Transit operators, offering capacity at varying prices and redundancy.

Cross connect to your business partners for secure connections.

Cloud and Content

Experience efficient delivery, scalability and reliability with our optimised cloud and content distribution solutions.

International cloud services providers enable compliance with data sovereignty laws and ensure customers can meet their varying requirements and spread their workloads across multiple providers.

Cloud and content distribution allows businesses to deliver their content and services more efficiently and with greater scalability.

Peering

Peering allows networks to directly connect and exchange traffic, improving communication and reducing IP transit costs.

By peering with other networks, businesses can improve the performance of their internet services and access new content and services.

Multiple IX exchanges provide redundancy and resiliency ensuring that there are multiple paths for traffic to travel between networks, improving latency.

Our team of experts can work with you to determine the best peering options for your business and ensure a smooth and seamless connection.

Get in touch with us today

Contact us

item.title: Virtual Machines
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
Onix Virtual Machines

Experience the power of virtual machines: a software-based emulation of physical computers that run on your existing hardware while functioning as independent systems seamlessly.

Talk to Us Today Development and Testing

Safe environments for developing and testing new software.

Server Consolidation

Continuous monitoring to preemptively address issues, maintaining system integrity.

Disaster Recovery

Rapid recovery solutions for business continuity.

Remote Work

Secure remote access to company resources.

Key Features of
Onix Virtual Machines

  • Reduced Hardware Requirement
  • Lower Energy Costs
  • Isolated Environments
  • Safe Testing Area

Security and Reliability

  • Isolated Environments
  • Secure Testing Area
  • Robust Physical and Network Security

Enhanced
Disaster Recovery

  • Easily backup and restore VMs
  • Minimise downtime after failures
  • Secure and reliable backup solutions

Cost Efficiency

  • Fewer physical machines needed
  • Decreased operational costs
  • Pay for what you use.

Flexibility and Scalability

Adaptability

Easily add or remove resources as business needs change.

Support for Various Applications

Run different operating systems and applications

Scalable Resources

Quickly scale up or down without new hardware.

Transform Your Business with Onix Virtual Machines

Contact us to start your journey with

GH₵2000 in free credits

Talk to Us Today

item.title: CFO
item.dc:creator: Yinka
item.content:encoded:
Resilient IT.

Predictable Costs.

No Capital Drain.

For CFOs who want infrastructure certainty, not surprises.

Request RIO Briefing

What Matters to CFOs and How Onix Delivers

Cost certainty over future projections

Measurable, near-term ROI

Risk reduction, not just tech upgrades

Full compliance, audit readiness

CFOs think in financial certainty,
not assumptions.

They prioritise near-term savings over
long-term promises.

Resilience and predictability win
over bells and whistles.

Onix colocation aligns with this
mindset, financially and operationally.

If your servers went down for just one hour, how much would it cost?

99.995%

Uptime Guarantee

  • Tier IV = 99.995% uptime
  • Built-in redundancy: power, cooling, connectivity
  • Compare with in-house risk: premiums, failures, repairs

Smart Spending Starts with Opex

Transform your IT infrastructure from a capital burden into a predictable operational expense.

Avoid CapEx drain

Flexible rack/pod/cage sizing

Pay-as-you-grow

No ongoing infrastructure maintenance

Infrastructure Designed for Auditors and CFOs Alike

Location Security

Built on elevated land, away from floods/fires

Green Energy

Solar power covers daytime use

Certifications

ISO 27001, 9001, PCI-DSS

Connectivity

Carrier-neutral: 30+ network options

Physical Security

8-layer physical security

Redundancy

Multiple power and cooling systems

Monitoring

24/7 monitoring and support

Compliance

Full audit readiness

Already Hosting Servers In-House? Or Thinking About It? Here's What You Need to Know

Whether you're maintaining a server room or planning to build one, the financial and operational risks are more significant than they first appear. Compare the reality of going it alone versus colocating with Onix.

Category In-House Setup (Existing or Planned) Onix Colocation
Initial
Investment 		High upfront spend on room fit-out, power systems, cooling, cabling, and security infrastructure No capital investment needed. Space, power, cooling already in place
Ongoing
Maintenance 		Recurring costs for A/C servicing, UPS batteries, generator maintenance, and hardware replacements Fully managed environment. All systems maintained by experts
Energy Costs Full utility rates with inefficient cooling and power management Solar-backed systems reduce power bills and increase efficiency
IT and Facilities Staff Internal teams required to manage power, environment, security, and compliance Optional remote hands. Onix takes care of operations so your team can focus elsewhere
Downtime Risk Vulnerable to outages and equipment failure. Recovery depends on internal response Tier IV-certified. Designed to run without interruption, with full redundancy
Security and Compliance Often limited to CCTV and basic access controls 8-layer physical security. ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and audit-ready
Scalability Limited by available space and power. Expanding requires new CapEx and planning Instantly scale up from racks to cages or modules
Connectivity Usually limited to one or two telcos. Upgrades can be costly and slow Over 30 carriers and cloud on-ramps available immediately
Hidden Costs Insurance, cooling inefficiencies, space rental, and unplanned repairs Transparent monthly billing. No surprises
Regulatory Burden Your team must handle all audits, reports, and risk controls We maintain a certified environment. Compliance support included

A good finance leader reduces risk while
managing spend. Colocation does both.

Spend Now,
Save More Than Money

CFOs are not afraid of spending. They are afraid of spending twice. Once on what doesn’t work, and again when it fails.

Investing in colocation now avoids the hidden costs that compound silently:

  • Unbudgeted downtime
  • Emergency repairs
  • Power cost inflation
  • Audit complications
  • Staff churn from infrastructure firefighting

Onix turns all of that into a flat, predictable operating expense. It frees up internal teams, reduces risk exposure, and delivers audit-ready compliance from day one.

Approving colocation today is not a gamble on the future. It is a shield against inevitable cost and complexity.

Real-World Example:

A Ghanaian Financial Institution

A mid-sized financial services firm in Accra had been operating its own server room for over 8 years. After an energy audit and risk review, the CFO realised the costs were escalating and the risks growing.

Their Setup (Before):

  • Annual A/C and UPS maintenance: GHS 128,000
  • Generator fuel and servicing: GHS 65,000
  • IT support and compliance audit time: 400+ hours annually
  • Power redundancy: None
  • Downtime incidents in 12 months: 3

After Migrating to Onix:

  • Colocation cost: GHS 10,000 per month (flat)
  • Uptime: 99.995 percent
  • Support: 24/7 remote hands, managed maintenance
  • Risk exposure: Reduced
  • Audit prep time: Cut by 70 percent

"We didn’t just reduce cost. We eliminated chaos,"
their CFO said. "And when the next audit came around, for once we were ready."

Start a Conversation Today

See what colocation with Onix would look like for your business with a tailored financial risk and ROI comparison.

Talk to us today
